_comment: US-2019 SHARED FIXTURE. Grading-readiness rules exist in two projects that cannot import each other: services/edge-functions/src/routes/flipdesk-grading.ts (gradingReadinessBlockers — the AUTHORITY, used by /validate and /submit) and src/lib/grading-readiness.ts (previewGradingReadiness — the web mirror driving the live Submit card). Both suites assert THIS table. Divergence is silent in both directions: a client saying ready when the server disagrees sends a seller into a submit-time rejection; a client saying not-ready when the server would accept blocks them from paying. US-2304 (owner's call, 2026-08-03): the TAG shot is required for GRADING. It is NOT required to LIST — src/lib/constants.ts keeps those as two separate lists (REQUIRED_PHOTO_TYPES vs REQUIRED_GRADING_PHOTO_TYPES), because folding them together would block the listing pipeline for every tagless garment, which is a different decision. The grading gate (image-quality.ts REQUIRED_IMAGE_TYPES) blocks on a missing label BEFORE any confidence scoring, so an item without one used to be charged, burn a vision call per photo, then abstain and refund. US-2397: the fabric close-up rule moved from blockers to WARNINGS — it no longer stops a submission, it caps the grade confidence and forces a human check instead, so a case with only that warning is READY. Blocker and warning strings are user-facing copy AND regex-matched by the web card (onlyGarmentBlocks), so changing one is a cross-project change.

blockers: Missing required photos: front, back, tag
warnings: No fabric close-up, so a person will check this grade before it is final. Add a detail photo of the weave/knit or a seam for a faster, more certain grade. This isn't a defect shot.
